search.input: Every string leaf in each effective local MCQ/PBQ, including metadata, stem/scenario, diagrams/logs/configuration, options/items/blanks/keys and explanations/feedback.

classificationDefinitions.direct_3_4_reasoning: At least one required answer decision tests a shared resilience/continuity/backups/testing method. Descriptive overlap only; no official relabeling, canonical mastery or component evidence.
classificationDefinitions.contextual_mention: Recovery/availability is operational context, prerequisite, metric/function/phase or contractual target; answer does not choose the reviewed 3.4 implementation/method.
classificationDefinitions.irrelevant: Different assessed understanding; term appears as distractor, wrong feedback, specialised non-continuity use or lexical collision.

limitations: Search is deterministic, broad and manually classified for every retained candidate, not proof that unmatched/local/private/live content cannot cover 3.4.
Original official labels and active mappings preserved; semantic overlap is not a new identity or approved family.
All PBQs remain coarse; p041/p043 captured trusted revisions are null and their grammar remains unsupported.
No drafts, teaching adoption, human approval, learner evidence, publication, runtime or deployment in this slice.
